title: Lantern Freight opens its dispatch rules
text:
Lantern Freight opened its dispatch rules to its own drivers this autumn, publishing the scoring the system uses to assign loads.

Mira Hollowell, the chief operating officer, said the rules were already an open secret among the drivers and that writing them down mostly removed arguments about whether the system had a favourite.

Hollowell has been with Lantern Freight since 2018 and is one of three officers named in the company filings.

The published rules went up on 30 September 2025 and have been amended twice since, both times after a driver pointed out a case the scoring handled badly.
